title: Rotary Cheese Grater Cheese Shredder, Cheese Grater Handheld with Strong Suction Base,Kitchen Vegetable Slicer 3 Replaceable Stainless Drum Blades for Fruit, Food, Nuts,Easy to Use Clean (Blue)
description:
About this item
【Durable and Safe】 Made from sturdy 430 stainless steel and BPA-free ABS plastic, the Mannilayco rotary cheese grater is built for long-lasting use. No electricity required—simply turn the hand crank for effortless grating.
【Humanized design】The drum-type rotary cheese grater with handle features powerful suction feet for stability. This efficient cheese shredder and vegetable grater saves time, making meal preparation more enjoyable with its hand crank design.
【Protective and Easy to Clean】The handle, transparent barrel, and food pusher protect your fingers from sharp blades. This detachable hand grater is easy to clean under running water or in the top rack dishwasher, making it an essential cooking gadget.
【3-IN-1 cheese shredder】Equipped with 3 drum blades for slicing, shredding, and grinding various ingredients. Perfect for cheese, radishes, carrots, cucumbers, potatoes, cookies, chocolate, broccoli, salads, and pizza toppings. Tips: Use slicing/coarse for soft cheese, fine for hard cheese.
【Customer Care】 Designed for hassle-free use, this rotary cheese grater is a great addition to any kitchen. Our dedicated support team is available to assist you, ensuring a smooth and satisfying experience. It also makes a thoughtful gift for family and friends on special occasions.

reviews_5s:
Idk what people are talking about. This grater is so helpful. Helpful hint to those that are struggling, you have to turn the knob on the side of the grater for it to stick to the counter. I haven't had any issues with it moving while I grater my cheese. I haven't tried to slice a potato yet so Ill have to update my review if that's not successful but sofar, I've used it several times to grater cheese and its been fine.It's a little small, a little plastic.
BUT, this thing ROCKS! I can grind a pound of cheese in 3minutes. All the parts are easy to clean, comes apart to make it easier.
The big one would be even more awesome but this one is prefect for trying the system out.
I don't plan to buy the big one. I just cut cheese into smaller chunks. Fondue is a snap!This shreds cheese quickly! It’s easy to use and easy to assemble. It’s also easy to take apart and clean. The suction holds well onto the counter. All you need is a low bowl for the cheese to fall into. It’s a good size and is easy to store in a cabinet.Works great easy to put together and take apartI love this and am so mad at myself for not buying it sooner! The design of this grater is so simple and easy to use. It shreds a whole block of cheese very very quickly. There is a little knob on the side that suctions the grater to the counter and let me tell you it is strong! But make sure the counter isn't wet or the grip will not grip right and it'll start sliding around while you are turnign the handle.

It is very easy to clean, as you just unscrew the handle and it lets go of the grater part. Once the handles is off it is small enough to store easily.
